basic_info.description: Sensational investment opportunity to own a semi-detached, single-family home with a sophisticated and classic facade, three bedrooms and situated in an outstanding Outer Parkside location! The home opens to a living room with a fireplace, original wood flooring, dining area adjacent to the large kitchen with skylights that is awash with natural light, two spacious bedrooms conveniently located at the rear of the home for privacy with outlooks to the yard and ocean, and a full bathroom all on the main level.  The lower level has an additional bedroom with a half-bathroom and direct access to the low maintenance flat backyard space ideal for gardening, entertaining, or repose.  The large garage with plenty of space for storage completes this special home that is close to shopping, restaurants, cafes, playgrounds, Ocean Beach, SF Zoo, and more!
